problems.title: Implement Trie

description.en: Implement a Trie (Prefix Tree) that supports insert, search, and startsWith operations. Process Q queries of the form: insert word, search word, startsWith prefix.
description.hi: Ek Trie (Prefix Tree) implement karo jo insert, search, aur startsWith operations support kare. Q queries process karo: insert word, search word, startsWith prefix.

examples.input:
insert apple
insert app
search apple
search ap
startsWith ap

explanation.en: apple and app inserted. apple found, ap is not a complete word, ap is a valid prefix
explanation.hi: apple aur app insert hue. apple mila, ap complete word nahi hai, ap valid prefix hai

constraints: Words contain only lowercase English letters

hints.en: Each node has 26 children (one per letter) and a boolean to mark end of word
hints.hi: Har node ke 26 children hain (har letter ke liye ek) aur ek boolean word ka end mark karne ke liye

hints.en: startsWith is same as search but does not check end-of-word flag
hints.hi: startsWith search jaisa hai par end-of-word flag check nahi karta

starterCode.python:
q = int(input())
# Process queries: insert, search, startsWith

testCases.input:
5
insert apple
insert app
search apple
search ap
startsWith ap

4
insert hello
search hello
search hell
startsWith hell

approach.en: Create TrieNode with children array and isEnd flag. Insert traverses and creates nodes. Search checks isEnd. StartsWith just checks path exists.
approach.hi: TrieNode banao children array aur isEnd flag ke saath. Insert traverse karta hai aur nodes banata hai. Search isEnd check karta hai. StartsWith sirf path exist karta hai check karta hai.

problems.title: Search Word with Wildcards

description.en: Design a data structure that supports adding words and searching for words with '.' wildcard. The '.' character can match any single letter. Given Q queries: addWord word or search pattern.
description.hi: Ek data structure design karo jo words add karna aur '.' wildcard ke saath search karna support kare. '.' character kisi bhi single letter ko match kar sakta hai. Q queries diye hain: addWord word ya search pattern.

examples.input:
addWord bad
addWord dad
search .ad
search b..
search b.d.

explanation.en: .ad matches bad and dad. b.. matches bad. b.d. has 4 chars, no match
explanation.hi: .ad bad aur dad se match karta hai. b.. bad se match karta hai. b.d. mein 4 chars hain, koi match nahi

constraints: Words contain lowercase letters, patterns contain lowercase letters and '.'

hints.hi: '.' ke liye saare 26 children ko recursively try karo

hints.en: Use DFS with backtracking for wildcard matching
hints.hi: Wildcard matching ke liye DFS with backtracking use karo

starterCode.python:
q = int(input())
# Process addWord and search queries

testCases.input:
5
addWord bad
addWord dad
search .ad
search b..
search b.d.

4
addWord apple
search appl.
search app..
search ....

approach.en: Use Trie. For search, when '.' is encountered, try all non-null children recursively.
approach.hi: Trie use karo. Search mein jab '.' mile to saare non-null children recursively try karo.

solution.timeComplexity: O(26^L) worst case for search with wildcards

description.en: Given N strings, find the longest common prefix among all of them using a Trie. If there is no common prefix, print empty string.
description.hi: N strings diye hain, Trie use karke sabka longest common prefix dhundho. Agar koi common prefix nahi hai to empty string print karo.

explanation.hi: Teeno words 'fl' se shuru hote hain

hints.en: Insert all words into Trie, then follow the path where each node has exactly one child and is not end of word
hints.hi: Saare words Trie mein insert karo, phir us path pe chalo jahan har node ka exactly ek child ho aur word ka end na ho

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
words = input().split()
# Find longest common prefix using Trie

approach.en: Insert all words into Trie. From root, follow the path while node has exactly one child and is not end of word.
approach.hi: Saare words Trie mein insert karo. Root se, tab tak path follow karo jab tak node ka exactly ek child ho aur end of word na ho.

description.en: Given a string s and a dictionary of words, determine if s can be segmented into a space-separated sequence of one or more dictionary words. Use Trie for efficient dictionary lookup.
description.hi: Ek string s aur words ki dictionary di hai, determine karo ki s ko space-separated sequence mein tod sakte hain jahan har part dictionary mein ho. Efficient dictionary lookup ke liye Trie use karo.

explanation.en: leetcode = leet + code, both in dictionary
explanation.hi: leetcode = leet + code, dono dictionary mein hain

examples.input:
catsandog
5
cats dog sand and cat

explanation.hi: Poori tarah se segment nahi ho sakta

hints.en: Build a Trie from dictionary. Use DP where dp[i] = true if s[0..i-1] can be segmented
hints.hi: Dictionary se Trie banao. DP use karo jahan dp[i] = true agar s[0..i-1] segment ho sakta hai

hints.en: For each position i where dp[i] is true, try to match words from position i using the Trie
hints.hi: Har position i jahan dp[i] true hai, wahan se Trie use karke words match karne ki koshish karo

starterCode.python:
s = input()
n = int(input())
dict_words = input().split()
# Check if s can be segmented

testCases.input:
catsandog
5
cats dog sand and cat

approach.en: Build Trie from dictionary. DP array dp[i] = can s[0..i-1] be segmented. For each true dp[i], traverse Trie from s[i] to mark further reachable positions.
approach.hi: Dictionary se Trie banao. DP array dp[i] = kya s[0..i-1] segment ho sakta hai. Har true dp[i] ke liye, s[i] se Trie traverse karke aage reachable positions mark karo.

description.en: Design an auto-complete system. Given a list of sentences with their frequencies, implement: input(char c) - if c is '#', save the current sentence and reset. Otherwise, return top 3 sentences that have the current input as prefix, sorted by frequency (descending), then lexicographically.
description.hi: Ek auto-complete system design karo. Sentences ki list unki frequencies ke saath di hai, implement karo: input(char c) - agar c '#' hai to current sentence save karo aur reset karo. Nahi to top 3 sentences return karo jo current input ko prefix ke roop mein rakhte hain, frequency (descending) se sort, phir lexicographically.

examples.input:
sentences: ["i love you", "island", "iroman", "i love leetcode"]
frequencies: [5, 3, 2, 2]
input: i, ' ', a, '#'
examples.output:
['i love you','island','i love leetcode']
['i love you','i love leetcode']
[]
[]

explanation.en: After typing 'i', top 3 by frequency. After 'i ', matches narrow down. 'i a' has no match. '#' saves 'i a'.
explanation.hi: 'i' type karne ke baad, frequency ke hisaab se top 3. 'i ' ke baad matches kam ho jaate hain. 'i a' ka koi match nahi. '#' 'i a' ko save karta hai.

hints.en: Store frequency at each end-of-sentence node in the Trie
hints.hi: Trie mein har sentence-end node pe frequency store karo

hints.en: Maintain a current prefix string. On each input, extend prefix and search Trie for top 3 matches
hints.hi: Current prefix string maintain karo. Har input pe prefix extend karo aur Trie mein top 3 matches search karo

starterCode.python:
# Design auto-complete system
# Read sentences, frequencies, and process input chars

testCases.input:
4
i love you 5
island 3
iroman 2
i love leetcode 2
4
i
 
a
#
testCases.expectedOutput:
i love you,island,i love leetcode
i love you,i love leetcode

approach.en: Build a Trie with frequency counts. On each input char, traverse Trie and collect all sentences using DFS. Sort by frequency desc, then lexicographically. Return top 3.
approach.hi: Frequency counts ke saath Trie banao. Har input char pe Trie traverse karo aur DFS se saare sentences collect karo. Frequency desc, phir lexicographically sort karo. Top 3 return karo.

solution.timeComplexity: O(N * L) for building, O(total chars) per query

problems.title: Count Distinct Substrings

description.en: Given a string, count the number of distinct substrings using a Trie. Include the empty string in the count.
description.hi: Ek string di hai, Trie use karke distinct substrings ki count dhundho. Empty string ko count mein include karo.

explanation.en: Distinct substrings: '', a, ab, aba, abab, b, ba, bab = 8
explanation.hi: Distinct substrings: '', a, ab, aba, abab, b, ba, bab = 8

constraints: s contains only lowercase English letters

hints.en: Insert all suffixes of the string into a Trie
hints.hi: String ke saare suffixes Trie mein insert karo

hints.en: Count of distinct substrings = number of nodes in the Trie + 1 (for empty string)
hints.hi: Distinct substrings ki count = Trie mein nodes ki count + 1 (empty string ke liye)

starterCode.python:
s = input()
# Count distinct substrings using Trie

approach.en: Insert all suffixes into Trie. Each new node created represents a distinct substring. Total nodes + 1 (empty string) = answer.
approach.hi: Saare suffixes Trie mein insert karo. Har naya node ek distinct substring represent karta hai. Total nodes + 1 (empty string) = answer.

problems.title: Replace Words
problems.titleHi: Words ko Roots se Replace Karo

description.en: Given a dictionary of root words and a sentence, replace each word in the sentence with its shortest root from the dictionary. If a word has no root in the dictionary, keep it unchanged.
description.hi: Root words ki dictionary aur ek sentence diya hai, sentence mein har word ko uske shortest root se replace karo jo dictionary mein hai. Agar word ka koi root dictionary mein nahi hai to use waise hi rakhho.

examples.input:
3
cat bat rat
the cattle was rattled by the battery
examples.output: the cat was rat by the bat

hints.en: Insert all roots into a Trie. For each word in sentence, find the shortest matching prefix in the Trie
hints.hi: Saare roots Trie mein insert karo. Sentence ke har word ke liye, Trie mein shortest matching prefix dhundho

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
roots = input().split()
sentence = input()
# Replace words with shortest roots

testCases.input:
3
cat bat rat
the cattle was rattled by the battery
testCases.expectedOutput: the cat was rat by the bat

testCases.input:
2
a aa
a aa aaa aaaa

approach.en: Build Trie from roots. For each word, traverse Trie char by char. If end-of-word found, use that root. Otherwise keep original.
approach.hi: Roots se Trie banao. Har word ke liye, char by char Trie traverse karo. Agar end-of-word mile to wo root use karo. Nahi to original rakhho.

solution.timeComplexity: O(D * L + S * W) where D=dict size, S=sentence words, L,W=word lengths

description.en: Given an array of N non-negative integers, find the maximum XOR of any two numbers in the array using a Trie of binary representations.
description.hi: N non-negative integers ka array diya hai, binary representations ka Trie use karke kisi bhi do numbers ka maximum XOR dhundho.

hints.en: Build a binary Trie (each node has children[0] and children[1]) storing 32-bit representations
hints.hi: Binary Trie banao (har node ke children[0] aur children[1] hain) jo 32-bit representations store kare

hints.en: For each number, try to go to the opposite bit at each level to maximize XOR
hints.hi: Har number ke liye, XOR maximize karne ke liye har level pe opposite bit ki taraf jaane ki koshish karo

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
nums = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Find maximum XOR using binary Trie

approach.en: Build binary Trie with 32 bits per number (MSB first). For each number, traverse Trie trying opposite bit at each level. This greedily maximizes XOR.
approach.hi: 32 bits per number (MSB pehle) ke saath binary Trie banao. Har number ke liye, har level pe opposite bit try karte hue Trie traverse karo. Ye greedily XOR maximize karta hai.
